datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = []
}

model Article {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  slug        String    @unique
  title       String
  description String
  body        String
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  tagList     Tag[]
  author      User      @relation("UserArticles", fields: [authorId], onDelete: Cascade, references: [id])
  authorId    Int
  favoritedBy User[]    @relation("UserFavorites")
  comments    Comment[]
}

model Comment {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  body      String
  editedAt  DateTime?
  article   Article  @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  articleId Int
  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  Int
}

model Tag {
  id       Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name     String    @unique
  articles Article[]
}

model User {
  id         Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  email      String    @unique
  username   String    @unique
  password   String
  image      String?   @default("https://api.realworld.io/images/smiley-cyrus.jpeg")
  bio        String?
  articles   Article[] @relation("UserArticles")
  favorites  Article[] @relation("UserFavorites")
  followedBy User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  following  User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  comments   Comment[]
  demo       Boolean   @default(false)
}

# Feature 3: soft delete for comments

## Rules relied on
Values are read from these sources, not copied here.
- Soft delete: what delete does, which comments lists hide, who may delete. policy-soft-delete.md
- Error body shape: policy-error-response.md (see conflict 1).
- Status codes: policy-error-response.md (unchanged), and the existing not-found branch in deleteComment, code-comment-ownership.md.
- Comment fields: schema.prisma (verified). code-comment-model.md is stale.
- Edit timestamp column: policy-edited-at-marker.md (untouched).
- Migrations: code-migrations.md for location. Undo note and fresh-database check: policy-release-checklist.md.

## Source conflicts
1. Error body: policy-error-response.md vs ops-runbook.md. Followed the policy, the dedicated rule that replaces the older shape. Runbook needs an update.
2. Comment fields: code-comment-model.md vs schema.prisma. Followed the schema.

## Scope
- Add the deletion timestamp as a nullable column, so existing rows stay live.
- deleteComment: set the timestamp instead of removing the row. Skip already-deleted comments in the lookup.
- getCommentsByArticle: exclude deleted comments.
- editComment: treat deleted comments as not found.
- One migration, with its undo note.

content.text:
I wrote the spec to `specs/feature-3-soft-delete.md`. It names each rule and its source without copying values, and it is a single Write call.

**Source conflicts**
1. **Error body shape:** `policy-error-response.md` says new errors use the error object. `ops-runbook.md` says new errors should use the errors-by-field shape. I followed the policy because it is the dedicated rule and says it replaces the older shape. The runbook needs an update, and I don't know which note is newer because the notes carry no dates.
2. **Comment fields:** `code-comment-model.md` says the model has no edit timestamp field. `schema.prisma` already has `editedAt` on `Comment`. I followed the schema, since it is the code. The note is stale.

**Code checks**
- `deleteComment` matches the ownership note: lookup by id and author, 404 when not found or not the author, and the 403 branch is unreachable.
- `main.ts` matches the error-shape note: the error handler sends the message as the whole body.
- `getCommentsByArticle` has no filter for deleted comments yet, which the feature must add.
- `editComment` returns a placeholder status of 500 for a refused edit, because no rule sets one. I left it alone, since this feature doesn't touch edits beyond the deleted-comment check.

**Choices I made in the spec** (you may want to redirect these)
- The deletion timestamp is a nullable column, so existing rows stay live. This is my inference from the soft delete rule, not a stated rule.
- A second delete of an already-deleted comment returns not found.
- `editComment` treats deleted comments as not found. The spec leaves the status to the existing not-found branch.
- The existing 404 response keeps its current behaviour, since it is not a new error.
